headline: Create or amend school policies on service and therapy animals, student activity accounts, community flyers, harassment, cell phones, and hiring.
summary: The meeting will consider contracts for administrators and employees. It will also review policies on animals, student activity accounts, community flyers, harassment, staff cell phone use, and hiring.
items: Approve template administrator and employee contracts
Approve distribution of community flyers policy
Create staff/teacher cell phone use in classrooms
